tasks.title: Validate dashboard and process route in the packaged Windows app
acceptance: Online telemetry appears in both routes
Offline state is truthful
Navigation selection stays synchronized with back navigation
Narrow and high-DPI layouts remain usable
tasks.notes: Dashboard has a clear landscape, separate crescent overlay, 280 animated rain drops, aurora, stars, lightning, CPU/memory gauges/history, and a rain mode control. Process telemetry exposes up to 512 accessible rows by memory with bounded names/payload and visible total-versus-shown count; PID 0 is excluded. Desktop EXE auto-start and graceful owned-service shutdown are smoke-verified. UI distinguishes app-running from service-offline and labels a live local snapshot ONLINE. Release build: 0 warnings/errors; 22 tests pass. Remaining: native Settings/navigation click-through and narrow/high-DPI layout review.

tasks.title: Implement read-only network inventory and Windows event sources
acceptance: Typed bounded event contracts
Connection inventory with clear collection scope

tasks.notes: Read-only per-interface byte counters and sampled receive/send rates plus up to 256 active TCP endpoints are implemented over an output-only schema-v1 pipe with 1 MiB/2 s client bounds. tasks.title: Port scan, threat-intelligence, vulnerability, and rule workflows
acceptance: Validated signed/TLS feed inputs
Sigma/YARA behavior compatibility documented
Cache age and source integrity visible
tasks.notes: Partial implementation: fixed-host CISA KEV HTTPS fetch, redirects disabled, 15s/12MiB/10k bounds, strict CVE/date/field validation, duplicate rejection, searchable Intel UI, and versioned atomic local cache with SHA-256 corruption detection, 24h stale label, and 7-day maximum age. Four cache tests cover round-trip, tampering, expiry, and invalid input. Remaining: source-signature strategy, additional feeds, local product matching, EPSS/NVD correlation, and Sigma/YARA compatibility. See docs/THREAT_INTELLIGENCE.md.

tasks.title: Implement durable configuration, history, and migration-safe local storage
acceptance: Transactional schema upgrades

tasks.notes: Partial implementation shipped in this checkpoint: one Settings route persists the wired visual preferences (rain effects, reduced motion, auto storm cycle) in per-user packaged local settings and labels fallback behavior. Settings toggle handlers were moved out of XAML to avoid early invocation during control construction after a user-reported crash; build/tests and process startup pass, but native interactive route confirmation remains outstanding. No secrets are stored. Transactional schema upgrades, DPAPI secrets, backup/restore, user-configurable scan/privacy policies, and audit/history storage remain outstanding.
